title: A Park Ranger Was Struck by Lightning Seven Times

scenes.text: One park ranger was struck by lightning seven times.
Roy Sullivan worked in Shenandoah National Park in Virginia.
The first hit came in 1942. It burned his leg and left a hole in his shoe.
Later bolts burned off his eyebrows and set his hair on fire.
The seventh strike came in 1977, and he survived all seven.
Guinness World Records still lists him. Seven strikes. One man.

description:
Park ranger Roy Sullivan was struck by lightning seven times between 1942 and 1977 and survived every one.
He is still listed in Guinness World Records for the most lightning strikes survived.
What would you do if lightning hit you twice?
first_comment: Bonus: he was nicknamed the human lightning conductor. Would you keep working outdoors after a second strike?
